definitions.explanation: Firm belief in the reliability or ability of someone or something.
The ability to obtain goods or services before payment based on trust that payment will be made in the future.

notes:
{信用|しんよう} has two main uses: interpersonal trust and financial credit.

SENSE 1 — TRUST:
- {信用|しんよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to trust someone
- {信用|しんよう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: trustworthy
- {信用|しんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose trust
- {信用|しんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to gain trust
- {信用|しんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧: to build trust

SENSE 2 — FINANCIAL CREDIT:
- {信用|しんよう}⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: credit card
- ⟦{信用|しんよう}{金庫|きんこ}→信用金庫：24783_shinyoukinko⟧: credit union
- {信用|しんよう}⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: margin trading
- {信用|しんよう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: credit check

CONTRAST:
- {信用|しんよう}: practical trust (based on track record, ability)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧: deeper trust (based on character, relationship)
